input.nodeUniverse: all IDs in the 424-row node dictionary, including isolated nodes

preprocessing.selfLoops: excluded by the selected no-autoregulation file; reject if encountered
preprocessing.parallelEdges: collapse exact duplicates; reject conflicting duplicates
preprocessing.mutualEdges: allowed by the convention; none occur in the selected network

census.connectedness: weak connectivity after ignoring edge direction
census.occurrences: each unordered three-node set counted at most once

onto2dCanonicalization.nodes: three anonymous nodes with the same frozen element ref
